description: React component for a multi-step form to make model groups public, including selection, filtering, and confirmation steps.

classes.name: ModelGroupInfo
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of model group data used within the form.

classes.name: MakeModelPublicFormProps
classes.description: Props interface for the MakeModelPublicForm React component.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets form state and closes the modal.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next step if at least one model is selected.

methods.name: handleModelSelection
methods.description: Updates selected models based on user checkbox input.

methods.name: handleSelectAll
methods.description: Selects or deselects all filtered models.

methods.name: handleFilteredDataChange
methods.description: Updates filtered data without clearing existing selections.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits selected models to make them public via API call.

methods.name: renderStep1Content
methods.description: Renders the UI for model selection step.

methods.name: renderStep2Content
methods.description: Renders the confirmation UI before making models public.

methods.name: renderStepContent
methods.description: Chooses which step content to render based on current step.

methods.name: renderStepButtons
methods.description: Renders navigation buttons for the form steps.
